# GitHub machine account for Claude: rayserrano2735-claude-ws

Ray, 2026-10-23. Claude contributes to this repository as a first-class developer under its own GitHub
machine account, so its work shows as its own, and Ray, as the other developer, can approve its pull requests
(GitHub does not let an author approve their own pull request). GitHub's terms allow one machine account per
person; Ray is the human responsible for it.

## Why (found 2026-10-23)

| Finding | Effect |
|---|---|
| 31 commits signed Claude <claude@users.noreply.github.com>, an address no account of ours owns | No contributor shown; the address format belongs to whichever GitHub user is named claude |
| Every push and pull request used Ray's token | Pull request #1 was opened by rayserrano2735, so Ray could not approve it |

## Ray's steps (GitHub interface)

| # | Step | Value |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Create the account | Username rayserrano2735-claude-ws (claude-ws belongs to an unrelated account created 2024-06-28); email maestrorayserrano@gmail.com; two-factor authentication on; password and recovery codes in Ray's personal vault. Created 2026-10-23 13:16 UTC, id 346915053 |
| 2 | Invite it | Write role (not Admin) on rayserrano2735/digest-datavault. Sent by Claude with Ray's token on 2026-10-23 (invitation 339332332) after confirming the account's creation date; accepted by Ray as the machine account |
| 3 | Its token | A classic token with the repo scope only, created signed in as the machine account. A fine-grained token cannot target a repository owned by another personal account (the resource owner list offered only the machine account itself), so the token is contained by the account's access instead: the account can reach exactly one repository. Inviting the machine account anywhere else widens what this token reaches. Verified 2026-10-23: acts as rayserrano2735-claude-ws, scopes repo, reaches only digest-datavault with push and without admin |
| 4 | Store it | 1Password vault Agentic Workstation, item "GitHub PAT claude-ws", field credential. Ray's own token stays for administration |

## Claude's steps (after step 4)

| # | Step |
|---|---|
| 5 | Read the token from the vault; confirm it acts as claude-ws and can reach only digest-datavault |
| 6 | Set the workstation's git identity for this repository to claude-ws and its GitHub no-reply address (the numeric form, read from the API) |
| 7 | Close pull request #1 and open the same branch into qa as claude-ws, with the same description; Ray reviews and approves it there |
| 8 | Record the change in the workstation canonical (bootstrap reads the new token for digest-datavault) |

Existing commits keep their old signature; history is not rewritten. The squash merge into qa carries the
pull request author's identity.
infra/scripts/dev_scoped_rebuild.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Development rebuild of one model and everything downstream of it (design D-20; guide G-12).
# Usage, from the repository root:  infra/scripts/dev_scoped_rebuild.sh <model_name>
# Refuses to run unless dbt's target database is a developer database (its name starts with DEV__):
# rebuilding is legitimate only where data can be replayed, never in QA or production.
set -euo pipefail
model="${1:?usage: dev_scoped_rebuild.sh <model_name>}"
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../../dbt"
db=$(dbt debug 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"database": *"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')
case "$db" in
  DEV__*) echo "Target database $db: rebuilding $model and everything downstream." ;;
  *) echo "Refused: target database '$db' is not a developer database (DEV__...). Rebuilds never run in QA or production." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
dbt build --full-refresh --select "${model}+"
infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py
"""
The vault's and the mart's DDL, one file per ER/Studio submodel (Ray, 2026-10-28, answers 2y and 3y; split 2026-11-01,
design D-55, DIG-604).

dbt creates the structures, so the DDL is reverse-engineered from a built environment with Snowflake's GET_DDL:
  infra/snowflake/ddl/vault.sql   RAW_VAULT
(REFERENCE, which holds the seeds, is in no file for now: Ray, 2026-11-02.)
  infra/snowflake/ddl/mart.sql    CONFORMED_DM
Each carries its tables, views, primary and foreign keys and comments. Database names are written as production's
(DV, LANDING), so each file describes every tier and can be compared with any of them.

Generate, on a release's branch, right after a dbt build in the developer's database:
  python3 infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py --database DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS --landing DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS -- <snow options>
Check a tier's deployed structure against the committed files (QA after its build, production after its build):
  python3 infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py --check --database DV_QA --landing LANDING_QA -- <snow options>
  python3 infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py --check --database DV --landing LANDING -- <snow options>
<snow options> are the Snowflake CLI's connection options, as the workstation's other scripts pass them.
--check exits 1 and shows the differences when either file's structure is not the one on record.
"""
import argparse, difflib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys

FILES = {"vault.sql": ["RAW_VAULT"], "mart.sql": ["CONFORMED_DM"]}  # one schema per file; REFERENCE, the seeds, in none for now (D-55)
DDL_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "snowflake", "ddl")
HEADERS = {
    "vault.sql": """-- The vault's structure: the raw vault schema of the DIGEST Data Vault course, for its ER/Studio
-- submodel. Generated from a built vault by infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py (Snowflake GET_DDL), with database names
-- written as production's (DV, LANDING). Each release commits its own version.
-- To propose a change to the structure, edit this file on a branch of your own: the diff is the proposal.
""",
    "mart.sql": """-- The mart's structure: the conformed mart schema of the DIGEST Data Vault course, for its ER/Studio submodel.
-- Generated from a built vault by infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py (Snowflake GET_DDL), with database names written as
-- production's (DV, LANDING). Each release commits its own version.
-- To propose a change to the structure, edit this file on a branch of your own: the diff is the proposal.
""",
}


def ddl(database, landing, snow, fname):
    """The normalized DDL of one file's schemas, in a fixed order."""
    sql = "\n".join(f"SELECT '{s}' AS S, GET_DDL('SCHEMA', '{database}.{s}', FALSE) AS D;" for s in FILES[fname])
    run = subprocess.run(["snow", "sql", "-i", "--format", "json", "--enable-templating", "NONE"] + snow,
                         input=sql.encode(), capture_output=True)
    out = run.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    try:
        results = json.loads(out)
    except ValueError:
        sys.exit("GET_DDL failed:\n" + out[:2000] + run.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:1000])
    if results and isinstance(results[0], dict):  # one statement: the CLI returns its rows, not a list of results
        results = [results]
    parts = []
    for rows in results:
        text = rows[0]["D"]
        for name, prod in ((database, "DV"), (landing, "LANDING")):
            text = re.sub(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b", prod, text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        # dbt signs each view's text with a comment naming its engine, version, target and run; it is not structure, and
        # it differs between Fusion and dbt-core and on every run, so it is removed (QA run 2, 2026-11-01)
        text = re.sub(r'/\* \{"app": "dbt".*?\} \*/', "", text)
        parts.append("\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in text.strip().splitlines()))
    return HEADERS[fname] + "\n" + foreign_keys_last("\n\n".join(parts)) + "\n"


def foreign_keys_last(text):
    """Every table without its foreign keys, then each foreign key at the end as its own statement (design D-55).

    ER/Studio's import dropped each foreign key that named a table defined later in the file, and GET_DDL has no
    option for the order, so the order is set here."""
    out, fks, table = [], [], None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"create or replace (?:transient )?table ([\w.\"]+)", line, re.I)
        if m:
            table = m.group(1)
        f = re.match(r"\s*(constraint \S+ foreign key \(.*?\) references .*?\))\s*,?\s*$", line, re.I)
        if f and table:
            fks.append(f"alter table {table} add {f.group(1)};")
            continue
        if line.startswith(")") and out and out[-1].rstrip().endswith(","):
            out[-1] = out[-1].rstrip()[:-1]
        out.append(line)
    body = "\n".join(out)
    fks.sort()  # by table, then key name: the text must not depend on the order the keys were created
    return body + ("\n\n" + "\n".join(fks) if fks else "")


def main():
    if "--" not in sys.argv:
        sys.exit("usage: vault_ddl.py [--check] --database DB --landing DB -- <snow connection options>")
    i = sys.argv.index("--")
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--database", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--landing", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args(sys.argv[1:i])
    differs = False
    for name in FILES:
        path = os.path.join(DDL_DIR, name)
        text = ddl(args.database.upper(), args.landing.upper(), sys.argv[i + 1:], name)
        if args.check:
            with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                recorded = f.read()
            if text == recorded:
                print(f"{args.database}: structure matches infra/snowflake/ddl/{name}")
                continue
            diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(recorded.splitlines(), text.splitlines(), f"{name} (committed)",
                                             f"{args.database} (deployed)", lineterm="", n=1))
            print(f"{args.database}: structure DIFFERS from infra/snowflake/ddl/{name} ({len(diff)} diff lines)")
            print("\n".join(diff[:80]))
            differs = True
            continue
        os.makedirs(DDL_DIR, exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
        print(f"wrote infra/snowflake/ddl/{name} from {args.database}: {text.count(chr(10))} lines, "
              f"{len(re.findall(r'create or replace (?:transient )?table', text, re.I))} tables, "
              f"{len(re.findall(r'create or replace (?:secure )?view', text, re.I))} views")
    if differs:
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
infra/scripts/workstation_setup.sh
#!/bin/sh
# The vault project's workstation setup (Provisioning — Agentic common, k1ki331, leaves a repository's own setup to
# its records). Run from the repository root after provisioning, as the workstation's user:
#   sh infra/scripts/workstation_setup.sh CLAUDE_WS
# 1. The dev dbt profile: the developer databases DEV__DV__<USER> and DEV__LANDING__<USER>, key-pair login.
# 2. The MetricFlow environment, from the connector's own requirements, so Mary's questions compile here as the
#    connector compiles them (Ray, 2026-11-01); boto3 for the connector's unit tests and AWS reads.
# 3. Playwright and its browser, for the QA retest (site/dev/qa_retest.py).
# 4. dbt-core with dbt-snowflake, QA's engine, beside Fusion, so the dev rehearsal runs the QA job's steps on the engine QA
#    uses before any pull request into qa (Ray, 2026-11-01: nothing is supposed to fail in QA).
set -eu
USER_NAME="${1:?the workstation's Snowflake user, such as CLAUDE_WS}"
KEY="${SNOWFLAKE_KEY:-$HOME/.op_secret/claude_ws.p8}"
umask 077; mkdir -p "$HOME/.dbt"
cat > "$HOME/.dbt/profiles.yml" <<PROFILE
digest_datavault:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: snowflake
      account: mgb11914.us-east-1
      user: $USER_NAME
      private_key_path: $KEY
      role: ${USER_NAME}_ROLE
      warehouse: COMPUTE_WH
      database: DEV__DV__$USER_NAME
      schema: RAW_VAULT
      threads: 8
PROFILE
umask 022
VENV="${MF_VENV:-$HOME/.agentic/mfvenv}"
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/pip" install -q -r infra/aws/requirements.txt boto3 playwright
"$VENV/bin/python" -m playwright install --with-deps chromium > /dev/null
CORE="${DBT_CORE_VENV:-$HOME/.agentic/dbtcore}"
python3 -m venv "$CORE"
"$CORE/bin/pip" install -q dbt-core dbt-snowflake
echo "dev profile: DEV__DV__$USER_NAME over DEV__LANDING__$USER_NAME (set DBT_LANDING_STORAGE=DEV__LANDING__$USER_NAME)"
echo "MetricFlow and Playwright: $VENV"
echo "dbt-core, QA's engine: $CORE/bin/dbt"
infra/snowflake/admin_separation.sql
/*
  Separate administration from development (Ray, 2026-10-23, answer 1y).
  RAYSERRANO becomes Ray's developer identity; a new RAYSERRANO_ADMIN holds the admin roles.
  Run by Ray, in this order: 1, 2, 2b, 3, 3b, 4, 6, then 5 after the environment tier setup. Step 4 must not run until step 3 has succeeded:
  removing ACCOUNTADMIN from the only user that holds it can lock the account.
*/

/* Step 1. See what RAYSERRANO holds today, so only the admin roles move.
   Read 2026-10-23: ACCOUNTADMIN, ORGADMIN, ALBA_ROLE, CIRO_ROLE, DCS_ROLE, VERA_ROLE.
   ACCOUNTADMIN and ORGADMIN move; the four project roles stay.
   Note: CIRO_ROLE holds SYSADMIN (SHOW GRANTS OF ROLE SYSADMIN, 2026-10-23), so RAYSERRANO
   still reaches SYSADMIN through CIRO_ROLE after step 4 unless that grant is revisited. */
USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
SHOW GRANTS TO USER RAYSERRANO;

/* Step 2. Create the admin user and give it the two admin roles RAYSERRANO holds (ACCOUNTADMIN, ORGADMIN).
   Set authentication in Snowsight after creation: a password with MFA, or a key pair. */
USE ROLE USERADMIN;
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS RAYSERRANO_ADMIN
    DEFAULT_ROLE = ACCOUNTADMIN
    COMMENT = 'Administration only. Daily development uses RAYSERRANO.';
USE ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN;
GRANT ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN TO USER RAYSERRANO_ADMIN;   /* contains SECURITYADMIN, SYSADMIN, USERADMIN */
GRANT ROLE ORGADMIN     TO USER RAYSERRANO_ADMIN;   /* organization-level administration */

/* Step 2b. Give the admin user a way to sign in to Snowsight: a temporary password that must be
   changed at first sign-in. Fill in the placeholder only in the worksheet you run; never commit a
   password, and keep it in a password manager. Snowflake requires MFA enrollment for human users
   signing in with a password; enroll at the first sign-in. */
USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
ALTER USER RAYSERRANO_ADMIN SET
    PASSWORD = '<a strong temporary password>'
    MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD = TRUE
    TYPE = PERSON;

/* Step 3. Sign in to Snowsight as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN while another RAYSERRANO session stays open as the
   way back (Ray, 2026-10-23: his DBeaver connection), change the password, enroll MFA, then confirm:
     USE ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN;  SELECT CURRENT_USER(), CURRENT_ROLE();
     USE ROLE ORGADMIN;      SELECT CURRENT_ROLE();
     USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN; SHOW GRANTS TO USER RAYSERRANO_ADMIN;
   Snowflake recommends more than one user holding ACCOUNTADMIN; consider a second,
   break-glass admin user before step 4. */

/* Step 3b. A break-glass administrator (Ray, 2026-10-23), created before step 4 so the account never
   depends on a single admin. Read 2026-10-23: only RAYSERRANO and RAYSERRANO_ADMIN hold ACCOUNTADMIN and
   ORGADMIN. Never used day to day; its own strong password and MFA, stored apart from RAYSERRANO_ADMIN's.
   Run as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN; fill the placeholder only in the worksheet, then sign in once to change the
   password, enroll MFA and confirm both roles, as in step 3. */
USE ROLE USERADMIN;
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS RAYSERRANO_BREAKGLASS
    DEFAULT_ROLE = ACCOUNTADMIN
    TYPE = PERSON
    COMMENT = 'Break-glass administrator. Not for daily use.';
USE ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN;
GRANT ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN TO USER RAYSERRANO_BREAKGLASS;
GRANT ROLE ORGADMIN     TO USER RAYSERRANO_BREAKGLASS;
USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
ALTER USER RAYSERRANO_BREAKGLASS SET PASSWORD = '<a strong temporary password>' MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD = TRUE;

/* Step 4. ONLY after step 3 succeeded, logged in as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN:
USE ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN;
REVOKE ROLE ACCOUNTADMIN FROM USER RAYSERRANO;
REVOKE ROLE ORGADMIN     FROM USER RAYSERRANO;
SHOW GRANTS TO USER RAYSERRANO;
*/

/* Step 5. Make RAYSERRANO a working developer, as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN, with the per-developer role
   (Ray, 2026-10-23, answer 3a). DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE is created by the environment
   tier setup (not yet written); run this step after it.
USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
GRANT ROLE DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE TO USER RAYSERRANO;
ALTER USER RAYSERRANO SET DEFAULT_ROLE = DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE;
SHOW GRANTS TO USER RAYSERRANO;
*/

/* Step 6. Clean slate for RAYSERRANO (Ray, 2026-10-23): revoke every remaining role, then add grants one
   at a time as real needs appear, each recorded here with its reason. Read 2026-10-23: the four project
   roles carried administrator-grade power: CIRO_ROLE inherits SYSADMIN, and DCS_ROLE holds CREATE USER
   and CREATE INTEGRATION. The roles themselves are not changed, so services that use them are unaffected;
   anything signed in AS RAYSERRANO (DBeaver, a connector) loses that access. Run as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN. */
USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
REVOKE ROLE ALBA_ROLE FROM USER RAYSERRANO;
REVOKE ROLE CIRO_ROLE FROM USER RAYSERRANO;
REVOKE ROLE DCS_ROLE  FROM USER RAYSERRANO;
REVOKE ROLE VERA_ROLE FROM USER RAYSERRANO;
ALTER USER RAYSERRANO SET DEFAULT_ROLE = PUBLIC;
SHOW GRANTS TO USER RAYSERRANO;

/* Grants added back, one per need (append below, newest last):
   - DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE: Data Vault course development and labs (environment_tiers.sql, part A)
   - PILOT_READ_ROLE: read the course material in Pilot, read-only, granted to DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE, Ray's one role
     (pilot_reader.sql; Ray, 2026-10-23: one role per person)
*/
infra/snowflake/connector_read_grants.sql
/*
  Mary's connector reads the conformed mart as CLAUDE_WS_ROLE alone, its session's secondary roles off (Ray, 2026-11-01,
  answer 1a, after QA found the connector reading through SYSADMIN). Every build grants SELECT on the conformed mart's
  views (dbt_project.yml, +grants) and USAGE on its schema (an on-run-end hook); this script grants the one thing a build
  cannot, USAGE on the database, which builds never drop. Run once per environment, the same in each, by the workstation
  as SYSADMIN, statements on standard input:
    snow sql ... -D vault=DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS | DV_QA | DV
  Refuses any other database before anything changes. Idempotent.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$
BEGIN
  IF ('<% vault %>' NOT IN ('DV_QA', 'DV') AND NOT STARTSWITH('<% vault %>', 'DEV__DV__')) THEN
    RETURN 1/0;  -- stops the script: only DV, DV_QA or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>
  END IF;
  RETURN 'granting database usage on <% vault %>';
END;
$$;

GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE <% vault %> TO ROLE CLAUDE_WS_ROLE;
SHOW GRANTS ON DATABASE <% vault %>;
infra/snowflake/correct_zero_key_satellite_rows.sql
/*
  One-time correction (Ray, 2026-10-28, answer 1a): the source rows that release 1 loaded on the zero key into two
  satellites. A row without a client number or insured id describes no one, so client_sunbelt_s held three such rows
  as one false client (two contradictory versions on 2026-10-01, a "change" on 2026-10-02) and insured_northfield_s
  one as a false insured (NF-100013). From this fix on, the satellites read only rows with a known key and the
  missing-key inspectors raise each such row as a finding; this script removes the rows loaded before the fix.

  Only source rows go: the package's own placeholder rows on the zero key (record source SYSTEM or ERROR) stay.
  Production holds four rows to remove (three client, one insured); a vault rebuilt after the fix holds none, so the
  script is safe to rerun and removes nothing there. The way back is Snowflake Time Travel on the two tables.

  Run by the workstation as SYSADMIN, naming the vault database, once, after the production build at promotion:
    snow sql ... -D vault=DV < infra/snowflake/correct_zero_key_satellite_rows.sql
  Refuses any database other than DV, DV_QA or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
USE WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH;

/* 0. Refuse anything but a vault database. */
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$
BEGIN
  IF ('<% vault %>' NOT IN ('DV', 'DV_QA') AND NOT STARTSWITH('<% vault %>', 'DEV__DV__')) THEN
    RETURN 1/0;  -- stops the script: only a vault database may be corrected
  END IF;
  RETURN 'correcting <% vault %>';
END;
$$;

/* 1. Before: the source rows on the zero key in each satellite. */
SELECT 'before' AS STEP,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.CLIENT_SUNBELT_S
         WHERE HK_CLIENT_H = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND RSRC NOT IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')) AS CLIENT_ROWS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.INSURED_NORTHFIELD_S
         WHERE HK_INSURED_H = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND RSRC NOT IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')) AS INSURED_ROWS;

/* 2. The correction. */
DELETE FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.CLIENT_SUNBELT_S
 WHERE HK_CLIENT_H = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND RSRC NOT IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR');
DELETE FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.INSURED_NORTHFIELD_S
 WHERE HK_INSURED_H = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND RSRC NOT IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR');

/* 3. After: none left; the placeholder rows (zero key and error key) still present. Returns 0, 0, 2, 2. */
SELECT 'after' AS STEP,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.CLIENT_SUNBELT_S
         WHERE HK_CLIENT_H = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND RSRC NOT IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')) AS CLIENT_ROWS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.INSURED_NORTHFIELD_S
         WHERE HK_INSURED_H = '00000000000000000000000000000000' AND RSRC NOT IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')) AS INSURED_ROWS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.CLIENT_SUNBELT_S WHERE RSRC IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')) AS CLIENT_PLACEHOLDERS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT.INSURED_NORTHFIELD_S WHERE RSRC IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')) AS INSURED_PLACEHOLDERS;
infra/snowflake/ddl/mart.sql
-- The mart's structure: the conformed mart schema of the DIGEST Data Vault course, for its ER/Studio submodel.
-- Generated from a built vault by infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py (Snowflake GET_DDL), with database names written as
-- production's (DV, LANDING). Each release commits its own version.
-- To propose a change to the structure, edit this file on a branch of your own: the diff is the proposal.

create or replace schema CONFORMED_DM;

create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE AGENT_POLICY_FACT (
	AGENT_POLICY_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The row''s key, the vault''s key for one agent and one policy.',
	AGENT_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The agent, an agent_dim key; the unknown agent''s key when a source names none.',
	POLICY_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The policy, a policy_dim key.',
	FIRST_NAMED_BY_SOURCE_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The first source to name this agent for this policy, a source_dim key (SSI or NFL).',
	FIRST_KNOWN_DATE DATE COMMENT 'The day the vault first received this agent for this policy.',
	constraint PK_AGENT_POLICY_FACT primary key (AGENT_POLICY_KEY)
)COMMENT='One agent named by at least one source as the one who sold a policy. Serves Q-11.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT (
	CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The row''s key, the vault''s key for one client, one policy and one role.',
	CLIENT_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The client, a client_dim key; the unknown client''s key when the sale gives no client number.',
	POLICY_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The policy, a policy_dim key; the unknown policy''s key for a sale with a blank policy number.',
	ROLE VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'What the client is on the policy, as the sales data sends it, owner, insured or payor.',
	SOLD_DATE DATE COMMENT 'The day the sale was made, from the current version of the sale; empty when the sale gives none.',
	FIRST_KNOWN_DATE DATE COMMENT 'The day the vault first received this role on this policy.',
	constraint PK_CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT primary key (CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_KEY)
)COMMENT='One role a Sunbelt Senior client has on one policy (owner, insured or payor). Serves Q-9 and Q-13.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE DAY_DIM (
	DATE_DAY DATE COMMENT 'One calendar day, 2026 or 2027.',
	constraint PK_DAY_DIM primary key (DATE_DAY)
)COMMENT='One row per day of 2026 and 2027; the time spine of the semantic layer (replaces MART.time_spine_day).'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE ORGANIZATION_DIM (
	ORGANIZATION_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The organization''s key in organization_h.',
	ORGANIZATION_CODE VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'The carrier code the organization sends.',
	ORGANIZATION_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The name the organization sends, from its current version; the ghost value for the ghost rows.',
	SOURCE_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The feed that sent the organization record.',
	constraint PK_ORGANIZATION_DIM primary key (ORGANIZATION_KEY)
)COMMENT='One organization as it names itself, from each carrier''s own organization record (mart design D-11).'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE PERSON_DIM (
	PERSON_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The person record''s key, the key of the hub that sent it; each ghost key once.',
	PERSON_ROLE VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'client, insured or agent; empty for the two ghost rows.',
	SOURCE_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The source that first sent the record, a source_dim key; SYSTEM or ERROR for the ghost rows.',
	FIRST_KNOWN_DATE DATE COMMENT 'The day the vault first received the record; empty for the ghost rows.',
	PERSON_NUMBER VARCHAR(32) COMMENT 'The number the source gives the person: client number, insured number or national producer number.',
	FIRST_NAME VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'A client''s first name, from its current version; empty for insureds and agents.',
	LAST_NAME VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'A client''s last name, from its current version; empty for insureds and agents.',
	FULL_NAME VARCHAR(129) COMMENT 'The person''s full name; an agent''s from the most recent sale naming the agent.',
	STATE VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'A client''s state, from its current version; empty for insureds and agents.',
	BIRTH_DATE VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'An insured''s birth date as sent; shown to consumers only through insured_dim''s mask.',
	ADDRESS VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'An insured''s address as sent; shown to consumers only through insured_dim''s mask.',
	constraint PK_PERSON_DIM primary key (PERSON_KEY)
)COMMENT='One person record as one source sent it, unmatched; client, insured and agent records each their own person (mart design D-10). Each ghost key once, with no role (D-14).'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE POLICY_DIM (
	POLICY_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The policy''s key in policy_h, carrier code and policy number together.',
	CARRIER_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The carrier, a carrier_dim key; the unknown organization when the code names no organization record.',
	POLICY_NUMBER VARCHAR(32) COMMENT 'The carrier''s policy number.',
	PLAN_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The plan, as the most recent sale names it; empty when no sale names the policy.',
	FIRST_NAMED_BY_SOURCE_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The first source to name the policy.',
	constraint PK_POLICY_DIM primary key (POLICY_KEY)
)COMMENT='One policy number per carrier; its plan as the most recent sale names it; a policy with no known carrier takes the unknown organization.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE POLICY_TERMS_FACT (
	POLICY_TERMS_KEY VARCHAR(32) COMMENT 'The row''s key, a hash of the policy key and the version''s load.',
	POLICY_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The policy, a policy_dim key.',
	VALID_FROM_DATE DATE COMMENT 'The day this version arrived.',
	VALID_TO_DATE DATE COMMENT 'The last day this version held; empty while it is the current version.',
	EFFECTIVE_DATE DATE COMMENT 'The day the carrier says the policy took effect.',
	FACE_AMOUNT NUMBER(12,2) COMMENT 'The face amount the carrier states, in US dollars as sent; empty when not sent.',
	STATUS VARCHAR(9) COMMENT 'The policy''s status in this version, as the carrier sends it (IF in force, LP lapsed).',
	constraint PK_POLICY_TERMS_FACT primary key (POLICY_TERMS_KEY)
)COMMENT='One version of a carrier''s terms for one policy, from one load until the next. Serves Q-10 and Q-14.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE SOURCE_DIM (
	SOURCE_KEY VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The permanent source system code.',
	SOURCE_NAME VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The source system''s current name.',
	OWNER VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'Who owns the source system.',
	constraint PK_SOURCE_DIM primary key (SOURCE_KEY)
)COMMENT='One source system, from the source system seed.'
;
create or replace view AGENT_DIM(
	AGENT_KEY COMMENT 'The agent''s key, a person_dim key.',
	AGENT_NPN COMMENT 'The agent''s national producer number.',
	FULL_NAME COMMENT 'The agent''s name, from the most recent sale naming the agent.'
) COMMENT='One agent record, by national producer number, a role view over person_dim.'
 as (

SELECT person_key AS agent_key, person_number AS agent_npn, full_name
FROM DV.CONFORMED_DM.person_dim
WHERE person_role = 'agent'
   OR source_key IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')   -- the two ghost rows, mart design D-14
  )
;
create or replace view CARRIER_DIM(
	CARRIER_KEY COMMENT 'The carrier''s key, an organization_dim key.',
	CARRIER_CODE COMMENT 'The carrier code.',
	CARRIER_NAME COMMENT 'The carrier''s name, as it sends it.'
) COMMENT='One carrier, a role view over organization_dim for the organizations sent through carrier feeds.'
 as (

SELECT organization_key AS carrier_key, organization_code AS carrier_code, organization_name AS carrier_name
FROM DV.CONFORMED_DM.organization_dim
WHERE source_key IN ('NFL', 'PMC')        -- organizations sent through a carrier feed
   OR source_key IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')   -- the two ghost rows, mart design D-14
  )
;
create or replace view CLIENT_DIM(
	CLIENT_KEY COMMENT 'The client''s key, a person_dim key.',
	CLIENT_NUMBER COMMENT 'Sunbelt Senior''s client number.',
	FIRST_NAME COMMENT 'The client''s first name.',
	LAST_NAME COMMENT 'The client''s last name.',
	STATE COMMENT 'The client''s state.',
	SOURCE_KEY COMMENT 'The source that first sent the client.',
	FIRST_KNOWN_DATE COMMENT 'The day the vault first received the client.'
) COMMENT='One client record of Sunbelt Senior, a role view over person_dim, with the two ghost rows (D-14).'
 as (

SELECT person_key AS client_key, person_number AS client_number, first_name, last_name, state,
       source_key, first_known_date
FROM DV.CONFORMED_DM.person_dim
WHERE person_role = 'client'
   OR source_key IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')   -- the two ghost rows, mart design D-14
  )
;
create or replace view FINDING_FACT(
	FINDING_KEY COMMENT 'The finding''s key in CONFIG.DATA_FINDING.',
	SOURCE_KEY COMMENT 'The source the flagged record came from, a source_dim key (SSI or NFL).',
	DETECTED_DATE COMMENT 'The UTC day the finding was written.',
	FINDER_NAME COMMENT 'The inspector or auditor that wrote the finding.',
	FINDER_TYPE COMMENT 'inspection or audit.',
	SOURCE_TABLE COMMENT 'The landing table of the flagged record.',
	SOURCE_COLUMN COMMENT 'The column that failed.',
	COLUMN_VALUE COMMENT 'The flagged value, or the name of the row when its key is missing.',
	STATUS COMMENT 'The finding''s status: detected until someone acknowledges it.',
	FINDING_KIND COMMENT 'form, the record arrived in a form the vault does not accept; missing_key, it arrived without a business key and was kept and flagged; audit, a count that does not reconcile.',
	FINDING_ROW COMMENT 'The row a finding names, its table and the row''s name, so a row missing two keys counts once.'
) COMMENT='One record an inspector or auditor flagged in the landing''s CONFIG.DATA_FINDING. Serves Q-15.'
 as (


SELECT finding_pk AS finding_key,
       CAST(CASE source_system WHEN 'SUNBELT' THEN 'SSI' WHEN 'NORTHFIELD' THEN 'NFL' ELSE source_system END AS VARCHAR) AS source_key,  -- source_dim's type, so the foreign key can be declared (guide step 82)
       TO_DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', detected_at)) AS detected_date,
       finder_name, finder_type, source_table, source_column, column_value, status,
       CASE WHEN finder_type = 'audit' THEN 'audit'
            WHEN ENDSWITH(finder_name, '_key_missing') THEN 'missing_key'
            WHEN ENDSWITH(finder_name, '_form') THEN 'form' END AS finding_kind,
       source_table || ': ' || column_value AS finding_row
FROM LANDING.CONFIG.data_finding
  )
;
create or replace secure view INSURED_DIM(
	INSURED_KEY COMMENT 'The insured''s key, a person_dim key.',
	FULL_NAME COMMENT 'The insured''s name, as Northfield Life sends it.',
	BIRTH_DATE COMMENT 'The birth year only, unless the session holds SYSADMIN.',
	ADDRESS COMMENT 'The state only, unless the session holds SYSADMIN.'
) COMMENT='One insured record of Northfield Life, a role view over person_dim; birth_date and address masked except for SYSADMIN (mart design D-9).'
 as (


SELECT person_key AS insured_key, full_name,
       CASE WHEN IS_ROLE_IN_SESSION('SYSADMIN') THEN birth_date ELSE LEFT(birth_date, 4) END AS birth_date,
       CASE WHEN IS_ROLE_IN_SESSION('SYSADMIN') THEN address ELSE RIGHT(TRIM(address), 2) END AS address
FROM DV.CONFORMED_DM.person_dim
WHERE person_role = 'insured'
   OR source_key IN ('SYSTEM', 'ERROR')   -- the two ghost rows, mart design D-14
  )
;

alter table AGENT_POLICY_FACT add constraint FK_AGENT_POLICY_FACT_AGENT_KEY foreign key (AGENT_KEY) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.PERSON_DIM(PERSON_KEY);
alter table AGENT_POLICY_FACT add constraint FK_AGENT_POLICY_FACT_FIRST_KNOWN_DATE foreign key (FIRST_KNOWN_DATE) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.DAY_DIM(DATE_DAY);
alter table AGENT_POLICY_FACT add constraint FK_AGENT_POLICY_FACT_FIRST_NAMED_BY_SOURCE_KEY foreign key (FIRST_NAMED_BY_SOURCE_KEY) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.SOURCE_DIM(SOURCE_KEY);
alter table AGENT_POLICY_FACT add constraint FK_AGENT_POLICY_FACT_POLICY_KEY foreign key (POLICY_KEY) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.POLICY_DIM(POLICY_KEY);
alter table CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT add constraint FK_CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT_CLIENT_KEY foreign key (CLIENT_KEY) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.PERSON_DIM(PERSON_KEY);
alter table CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT add constraint FK_CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT_FIRST_KNOWN_DATE foreign key (FIRST_KNOWN_DATE) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.DAY_DIM(DATE_DAY);
alter table CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT add constraint FK_CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT_POLICY_KEY foreign key (POLICY_KEY) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.POLICY_DIM(POLICY_KEY);
alter table CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT add constraint FK_CLIENT_POLICY_ROLE_FACT_SOLD_DATE foreign key (SOLD_DATE) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.DAY_DIM(DATE_DAY);
alter table POLICY_DIM add constraint FK_POLICY_DIM_CARRIER_KEY foreign key (CARRIER_KEY) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.ORGANIZATION_DIM(ORGANIZATION_KEY);
alter table POLICY_TERMS_FACT add constraint FK_POLICY_TERMS_FACT_EFFECTIVE_DATE foreign key (EFFECTIVE_DATE) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.DAY_DIM(DATE_DAY);
alter table POLICY_TERMS_FACT add constraint FK_POLICY_TERMS_FACT_POLICY_KEY foreign key (POLICY_KEY) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.POLICY_DIM(POLICY_KEY);
alter table POLICY_TERMS_FACT add constraint FK_POLICY_TERMS_FACT_VALID_FROM_DATE foreign key (VALID_FROM_DATE) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.DAY_DIM(DATE_DAY);
alter table POLICY_TERMS_FACT add constraint FK_POLICY_TERMS_FACT_VALID_TO_DATE foreign key (VALID_TO_DATE) references DV.CONFORMED_DM.DAY_DIM(DATE_DAY);

-- The vault's structure: the raw vault schema of the DIGEST Data Vault course, for its ER/Studio
-- submodel. Generated from a built vault by infra/scripts/vault_ddl.py (Snowflake GET_DDL), with database names
-- written as production's (DV, LANDING). Each release commits its own version.
-- To propose a change to the structure, edit this file on a branch of your own: the diff is the proposal.

create or replace schema RAW_VAULT;

create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE AGENT_H (
	HK_AGENT_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of agent_h: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	AGENT_NPN VARCHAR(10) COMMENT 'The agent''s national producer number, the same in every source; the agent''s business key.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_AGENT_H primary key (HK_AGENT_H)
)COMMENT='One row per agent, by national producer number, fed by both Sunbelt Senior''s sales data and Northfield Life''s policy data.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE AGENT_POLICY_L (
	HK_AGENT_POLICY_L VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of agent_policy_l: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	HK_AGENT_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the agent, a foreign key to agent_h.',
	HK_POLICY_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the policy, a foreign key to policy_h.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_AGENT_POLICY_L primary key (HK_AGENT_POLICY_L)
)COMMENT='One row per agent and policy, from both sources; where the sources disagree on a policy''s agent, both rows are kept.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE CLIENT_H (
	HK_CLIENT_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of client_h: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	CLIENT_NUMBER VARCHAR(32) COMMENT 'Sunbelt Senior''s client number as first sent; its trimmed, upper-case form is hashed into the key.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_CLIENT_H primary key (HK_CLIENT_H)
)COMMENT='Hub of Sunbelt Senior Insurance client numbers (increment 1 design D-3): one row per client key, with the load timestamp and record source of the key''s first arrival, plus the two ghost records.\n'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE CLIENT_POLICY_L (
	HK_CLIENT_POLICY_L VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of client_policy_l: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	HK_CLIENT_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the client, a foreign key to client_h.',
	HK_POLICY_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the policy, a foreign key to policy_h.',
	ROLE VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'The client''s role on the policy as Sunbelt Senior sends it: owner, insured or payor; one client can appear in two roles on one policy.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_CLIENT_POLICY_L primary key (HK_CLIENT_POLICY_L)
)COMMENT='One row per client, policy and role, from Sunbelt Senior''s sales data; the role is a dependent child key.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE CLIENT_POLICY_SUNBELT_S (
	HK_CLIENT_POLICY_L VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of client_policy_l, a foreign key to it.',
	HD_CLIENT_POLICY_SUNBELT_S VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The change hash: the hash of the descriptive columns, compared with the latest version to detect a change.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	SOLD_ON VARCHAR(10) COMMENT 'The date of the sale.',
	AGENT_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The selling agent''s name as written on the sale.',
	PLAN_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'Sunbelt Senior''s name for the product sold.',
	constraint PK_CLIENT_POLICY_SUNBELT_S primary key (HK_CLIENT_POLICY_L, LDTS)
)COMMENT='The details of a sale as Sunbelt Senior''s sales data sends them, per client, policy and role; one row per change.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE CLIENT_SUNBELT_S (
	HK_CLIENT_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the client, a foreign key to client_h.',
	HD_CLIENT_SUNBELT_S VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The change hash: the hash of the descriptive columns, compared with the latest version to detect a change.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	FIRST_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The client''s first name.',
	LAST_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The client''s last name.',
	STATE VARCHAR(9) COMMENT 'The client''s two-letter state code.',
	constraint PK_CLIENT_SUNBELT_S primary key (HK_CLIENT_H, LDTS)
)COMMENT='The client''s details as Sunbelt Senior''s client list sends them; one row per change.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE INSURED_H (
	HK_INSURED_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of insured_h: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	INSURED_NUMBER VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'Northfield Life''s number for the insured person, NLI- and five digits; the insured''s business key.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_INSURED_H primary key (HK_INSURED_H)
)COMMENT='One row per Northfield Life insured number.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE INSURED_NORTHFIELD_S (
	HK_INSURED_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the insured, a foreign key to insured_h.',
	HD_INSURED_NORTHFIELD_S VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The change hash: the hash of the descriptive columns, compared with the latest version to detect a change.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	INSURED_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The insured''s name in one field, Last, First.',
	BIRTH_DATE VARCHAR(10) COMMENT 'The insured''s birth date.',
	ADDRESS VARCHAR(128) COMMENT 'The insured''s address in one field, kept as sent.',
	constraint PK_INSURED_NORTHFIELD_S primary key (HK_INSURED_H, LDTS)
)COMMENT='The insured''s details as Northfield Life sends them; one row per change, a change in letter case included.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE INSURED_POLICY_L (
	HK_INSURED_POLICY_L VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of insured_policy_l: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	HK_INSURED_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the insured, a foreign key to insured_h.',
	HK_POLICY_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the policy, a foreign key to policy_h.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_INSURED_POLICY_L primary key (HK_INSURED_POLICY_L)
)COMMENT='One row per insured and policy, from Northfield Life''s policy data.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE ORGANIZATION_H (
	HK_ORGANIZATION_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of organization_h: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	CARRIER_CODE VARCHAR(16) COMMENT 'The carrier''s code, such as NFL for Northfield Life or PMC for Pinecrest Mutual. The organization''s business key.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_ORGANIZATION_H primary key (HK_ORGANIZATION_H)
)COMMENT='One row per carrier organization, keyed by carrier code, from each carrier''s own organization record.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE ORGANIZATION_NORTHFIELD_S (
	HK_ORGANIZATION_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the organization, a foreign key to organization_h.',
	HD_ORGANIZATION_NORTHFIELD_S VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The change hash: the hash of the descriptive columns, compared with the latest version to detect a change.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	CARRIER_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The carrier''s name as its own organization record gives it.',
	constraint PK_ORGANIZATION_NORTHFIELD_S primary key (HK_ORGANIZATION_H, LDTS)
)COMMENT='Northfield Life''s own organization record; one row per change.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE ORGANIZATION_PINECREST_S (
	HK_ORGANIZATION_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the organization, a foreign key to organization_h.',
	HD_ORGANIZATION_PINECREST_S VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The change hash: the hash of the descriptive columns, compared with the latest version to detect a change.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	CARRIER_NAME VARCHAR(64) COMMENT 'The carrier''s name as its own organization record gives it.',
	constraint PK_ORGANIZATION_PINECREST_S primary key (HK_ORGANIZATION_H, LDTS)
)COMMENT='Pinecrest Mutual''s own organization record; one row per change.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE POLICY_H (
	HK_POLICY_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of policy_h: the hash of its business key, and its primary key.',
	CARRIER_CODE VARCHAR(8) COMMENT 'The carrier''s code, such as NFL for Northfield Life or PMC for Pinecrest Mutual. A policy number is unique only within its carrier, so the code is part of the key.',
	POLICY_NUMBER VARCHAR(32) COMMENT 'The policy number as the carrier issued it, first sighting kept; with the carrier code, the policy''s business key.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_POLICY_H primary key (HK_POLICY_H)
)COMMENT='One row per policy, keyed by the issuing carrier''s code with the policy number; fed by Sunbelt Senior''s sales data and the carriers'' policy data.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE POLICY_NORTHFIELD_S (
	HK_POLICY_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the policy, a foreign key to policy_h.',
	HD_POLICY_NORTHFIELD_S VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The change hash: the hash of the descriptive columns, compared with the latest version to detect a change.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	FACE_AMOUNT NUMBER(12,2) COMMENT 'The death benefit, in dollars.',
	STATUS VARCHAR(9) COMMENT 'The policy''s status code: IF in force, LP lapsed, TR terminated.',
	EFFECTIVE_DATE VARCHAR(10) COMMENT 'The date the policy took effect.',
	constraint PK_POLICY_NORTHFIELD_S primary key (HK_POLICY_H, LDTS)
)COMMENT='The policy''s terms as Northfield Life sends them; one row per change.'
;
create or replace TRANSIENT TABLE POLICY_ORGANIZATION_L (
	HK_POLICY_ORGANIZATION_L VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The link''s hash key: the hash of the organization''s carrier code, then the policy''s carrier code and policy number; its primary key.',
	HK_POLICY_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the policy, a foreign key to policy_h.',
	HK_ORGANIZATION_H VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The hash key of the carrier organization, a foreign key to organization_h.',
	LDTS TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9) COMMENT 'The load time: when the vault received this row, in UTC.',
	RSRC VARCHAR(16777216) COMMENT 'The record source: the code of the source system that sent the row, a key to the source system seed.',
	constraint PK_POLICY_ORGANIZATION_L primary key (HK_POLICY_ORGANIZATION_L)
)COMMENT='One row per policy and the carrier organization that issued it, from Sunbelt Senior''s sales data and Northfield Life''s policy data (design D-57).'
;
create or replace view CLIENT_POLICY_SUNBELT_S1(
	HK_CLIENT_POLICY_L COMMENT 'The hash key of client_policy_l, a foreign key to it.',
	HD_CLIENT_POLICY_SUNBELT_S COMMENT 'The change hash: the hash of the descriptive columns, compared with the latest version to detect a change.',

	LEDTS COMMENT 'The load end time: one microsecond before the next version''s load time; 8888-12-31 23:59:59 for the current version.',
	SOLD_ON COMMENT 'The date of the sale.',
	AGENT_NAME COMMENT 'The selling agent''s name as written on the sale.',
	PLAN_NAME COMMENT 'Sunbelt Senior''s name for the product sold.'
) COMMENT='Each version of client_policy_sunbelt_s with its load end time.'

        "INSURED_NAME",
        "BIRTH_DATE",
        "ADDRESS"
    FROM DV.RAW_VAULT.insured_northfield_s

)

infra/snowflake/dev_mart_schema.sql
/*
  DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS.MART was created for Kimi's connector fixture (INFRA_SMOKE, MF_TIME_SPINE), outside the
  developer's role, so the developer build could not add the first mart views (Ray, 2026-10-26). The schema goes to the
  developer's builder role, grants kept; the fixture's tables stay where they are. Run by the workstation as SYSADMIN.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON SCHEMA DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS.MART TO ROLE DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
SHOW GRANTS ON SCHEMA DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS.MART;
infra/snowflake/drop_mart_views.sql
/*
  Drop the release 1 mart's five MART views (mart design D-6, section 4.4; guide step 78): the conformed mart in
  CONFORMED_DM replaces them, and DV Digest reloads from the build. Lists the MART views before and after.

  Run by the workstation as SYSADMIN, statements on standard input, naming the vault database:
    QA:          snow sql ... -D vault=DV_QA < infra/snowflake/drop_mart_views.sql
    Development: snow sql ... -D vault=DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS < (the same)
    Production:  -D vault=DV, at the promotion that carries the conformed mart.
  Refuses any database but DV_QA, DV or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>. Safe to rerun.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
USE WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH;

/* 0. Refuse an unknown database before anything changes. */
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$
BEGIN
  IF ('<% vault %>' NOT IN ('DV_QA', 'DV') AND NOT STARTSWITH('<% vault %>', 'DEV__DV__')) THEN
    RETURN 1/0;  -- stops the script: only DV_QA, DV or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>
  END IF;
  RETURN 'dropping the MART views of <% vault %>';
END;
$$;

/* 1. The MART views before the drop. */
SELECT table_name FROM <% vault %>.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_schema = 'MART' ORDER BY table_name;

/* 2. Drop the five. */
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS <% vault %>.MART.CLIENT_POLICY_FACT;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS <% vault %>.MART.AGENT_POLICY_FACT;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS <% vault %>.MART.POLICY_FACT;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS <% vault %>.MART.FINDING_FACT;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS <% vault %>.MART.TIME_SPINE_DAY;

/* 3. The MART views after: none of the five. */
SELECT table_name FROM <% vault %>.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE table_schema = 'MART' ORDER BY table_name;
infra/snowflake/dv_qa_role.sql
/*
  The workstation's part of the QA split (Ray, 2026-10-26, answer 1b), after Ray's infra/snowflake/service_users.sql:
  DV_QA_ROLE takes the warehouse and the ownership of DV_QA from DV_ROLE. LANDING_QA's grants move with the next
  run of infra/snowflake/refresh_landing_tier.sql (QA tier). Run by the workstation as SYSADMIN, statements on
  standard input. Idempotent.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
USE WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH;
GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH TO ROLE DV_QA_ROLE;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE DV_QA TO ROLE DV_QA_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE DV_QA TO ROLE DV_QA_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
SHOW GRANTS ON DATABASE DV_QA;
infra/snowflake/environment_tiers.sql
/*
  Environment tiers for digest-datavault (Ray, 2026-10-23, answer 1y).

    Tier         Landing (sources, STORAGE, CONFIG)   Vault (dbt builds)       Builder role
    production   LANDING                              DV                       DV_ROLE
    QA           LANDING_QA (clone of LANDING)        DV_QA                    DV_QA_ROLE
    developer    DEV__LANDING__<USER> (clone)         DEV__DV__<USER>          DEV_<USER>_ROLE

  LANDING_ROLE owns every landing database; LANDING_READ_ROLE reads them. Each developer role has the same
  shape on its own databases that DV_ROLE has in production and QA, so a privilege fault shows in development
  first. Idempotent where Snowflake allows; the clones are replaced on every run.

  PART A, run by Ray as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN: roles and role grants only.
  PART B, run by the workstation as SYSADMIN, after part A: databases, clones, ownership, object grants.

  WHAT EACH ROLE RECEIVES (and where):
    LANDING_ROLE         ownership of LANDING, LANDING_QA, DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO, DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS,
                         their schemas and tables (B2); warehouse usage (B opening); granted to SYSADMIN (A)
    LANDING_READ_ROLE    usage on every landing database and its schemas, select on its tables (B3);
                         granted to SYSADMIN (A)
    (QA split, Ray 2026-10-26: DV_QA_ROLE takes DV_ROLE's place on LANDING_QA and owns DV_QA; service_users.sql)
    DV_ROLE              on LANDING and LANDING_QA: usage, select on all tables, create table and view and
                         modify on STORAGE and CONFIG, insert, update, delete on CONFIG's tables (B3);
                         ownership of DV_QA (B5); already owns DV and holds warehouse usage
    DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE  the same as DV_ROLE, on DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO (B3); ownership of DEV__DV__RAYSERRANO
                         (B5); warehouse usage (B opening); granted to user RAYSERRANO as default role (A)
    DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE   the same as DV_ROLE, on DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS (B3); ownership of DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS
                         (B5); warehouse usage (B opening); granted to CLAUDE_WS_ROLE (A)

  DEFERRED (needs MANAGE GRANTS, an administrator privilege): future grants, so readers see tables created
  later in STORAGE. Not needed until the first increment that writes STORAGE history; builders own the
  tables they create. Found 2026-10-23 when part B's first run failed on them.
*/

/* ===================== PART A (RAYSERRANO_ADMIN) ===================== */
USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS LANDING_ROLE        COMMENT = 'Owns the landing databases (LANDING, LANDING_QA, DEV__LANDING__*)';
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS LANDING_READ_ROLE   COMMENT = 'Reads every landing database';
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE COMMENT = 'Developer role for RAYSERRANO: builder of DEV__DV__RAYSERRANO on DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO';
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE  COMMENT = 'Developer role for CLAUDE_WS: builder of DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS on DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS';
GRANT ROLE LANDING_ROLE        TO ROLE SYSADMIN;
GRANT ROLE LANDING_READ_ROLE   TO ROLE SYSADMIN;
GRANT ROLE DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE TO ROLE SYSADMIN;
GRANT ROLE DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE  TO ROLE SYSADMIN;
GRANT ROLE DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE TO USER RAYSERRANO;          /* admin runbook step 5 */
ALTER USER RAYSERRANO SET DEFAULT_ROLE = DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE;
GRANT ROLE DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE  TO ROLE CLAUDE_WS_ROLE;

/* ===================== PART B (workstation, SYSADMIN) ===================== */
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
USE WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH;
GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH TO ROLE DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE;
GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH TO ROLE DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE;
GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE;

/* B1. Clones of production landing, taken before production's CONFIG is cleared (B4), so the workstation's
   development findings and baselines move into its own clone. */
CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE LANDING_QA               CLONE LANDING;
CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO CLONE LANDING;
CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS  CLONE LANDING;

/* B2. Every landing database owned by LANDING_ROLE, grants preserved. */
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE LANDING TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE LANDING TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL TABLES  IN DATABASE LANDING TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE LANDING_QA TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE LANDING_QA TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL TABLES  IN DATABASE LANDING_QA TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL TABLES  IN DATABASE DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL TABLES  IN DATABASE DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;

/* B3. Builder and reader grants, as the owner. Database-level grants do not survive a clone,
   so each database is granted explicitly. */
USE ROLE LANDING_ROLE;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$
DECLARE
  pairs ARRAY := ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(
    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('LANDING', 'DV_ROLE'),
    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('LANDING_QA', 'DV_QA_ROLE'),
    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO', 'DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE'),
    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS', 'DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE'));
  db STRING; b STRING; i INTEGER;
BEGIN
  FOR i IN 0 TO ARRAY_SIZE(pairs) - 1 DO
    db := pairs[i][0]; b := pairs[i][1];
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE ' || db || ' TO ROLE ' || b;
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT USAGE ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE ' || db || ' TO ROLE ' || b;
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN DATABASE ' || db || ' TO ROLE ' || b;
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, MODIFY ON SCHEMA ' || db || '.STORAGE TO ROLE ' || b;
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, MODIFY ON SCHEMA ' || db || '.CONFIG TO ROLE ' || b;
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA ' || db || '.CONFIG TO ROLE ' || b;
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE ' || db || ' TO ROLE LANDING_READ_ROLE';
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT USAGE ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE ' || db || ' TO ROLE LANDING_READ_ROLE';
    EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN DATABASE ' || db || ' TO ROLE LANDING_READ_ROLE';
  END FOR;
  RETURN 'landing grants applied to ' || ARRAY_SIZE(pairs) || ' databases';
END;
$$;

/* B4. Production CONFIG starts clean: its findings and baselines came from the workstation's development
   builds, which B1 carried into DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS. CONFIG holds no source data. */
TRUNCATE TABLE LANDING.CONFIG.DATA_FINDING;
TRUNCATE TABLE LANDING.CONFIG.BUILD_BASELINE;
TRUNCATE TABLE LANDING_QA.CONFIG.DATA_FINDING;
TRUNCATE TABLE LANDING_QA.CONFIG.BUILD_BASELINE;
TRUNCATE TABLE DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO.CONFIG.DATA_FINDING;
TRUNCATE TABLE DEV__LANDING__RAYSERRANO.CONFIG.BUILD_BASELINE;

/* B5. Vault databases. DV (production) exists, owned by DV_ROLE. */
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS DV_QA;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE DV_QA TO ROLE DV_QA_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS DEV__DV__RAYSERRANO;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE DEV__DV__RAYSERRANO TO ROLE DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS TO ROLE DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
infra/snowflake/landing.sql
/*
  LANDING: landed sources, Pragmatic Data Platform storage, and testing configuration
  for the DIGEST Data Vault course (increment 1 design D-1). Owned by SYSADMIN. Access is granted directly to
  CLAUDE_WS_ROLE; no per-function roles (Ray, 2026-10-23, answer 3b, a recorded
  deviation from guide decision G-2). Idempotent: safe to run again.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;

CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS LANDING;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS LANDING.SUNBELT;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS LANDING.STORAGE;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS LANDING.CONFIG;

/* Source table: one acquired agency's client file (increment 1 profile, item 267). */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS LANDING.SUNBELT.CLIENT (
    CRM_ROW_ID      NUMBER          NOT NULL,
    CLIENT_NUMBER   VARCHAR(32),
    FIRST_NAME      VARCHAR(64),
    LAST_NAME       VARCHAR(64),
    STATE           VARCHAR(2),
    LOADED_AT       VARCHAR(19)     NOT NULL
);

/* Findings written by inspectors (layer 5) and auditors (layer 6). Columns
   FINDER_NAME and FINDER_TYPE (Ray, 2026-10-22). */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS LANDING.CONFIG.DATA_FINDING (
    FINDING_PK          VARCHAR(128)    NOT NULL,
    SOURCE_SYSTEM       VARCHAR(32)     NOT NULL,
    SOURCE_TABLE        VARCHAR(256),
    SOURCE_COLUMN       VARCHAR(128),
    COLUMN_VALUE        VARCHAR(512),
    FINDER_NAME         VARCHAR(128)    NOT NULL,
    FINDER_TYPE         VARCHAR(32)     NOT NULL,
    DETAIL              VARCHAR(2048),
    STATUS              VARCHAR(32)     DEFAULT 'detected',
    FINDING_ID          VARCHAR(32),
    NOTES               VARCHAR(1024),
    ROOT_CAUSE          VARCHAR(2048),
    DETECTED_AT         TIMESTAMP_TZ    DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
    ACKNOWLEDGED_BY     VARCHAR(64),
    ACKNOWLEDGED_AT     TIMESTAMP_TZ
);

/* Before and after snapshots for capture_baseline and verify_build. */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS LANDING.CONFIG.BUILD_BASELINE (
    SNAPSHOT_TYPE       VARCHAR(10)     NOT NULL,
    TABLE_NAME          VARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    METRIC_NAME         VARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,

infra/snowflake/pilot_reader.sql
/*
  Read-only access to Pilot (AGENTIC.DATASKILLS) for the learner (Ray, 2026-10-23, answer 1y).
  The course's lessons, records, delivery documents, rubric and acceptance log live in Pilot; the learner
  reads them, and only the procedures and the teacher write them. First grant added back to RAYSERRANO
  after the clean slate (admin_separation.sql, step 6).
  Ownership read 2026-10-23: SYSADMIN owns AGENTIC, DATASKILLS, its 17 tables and 3 views.

  PART A, run by Ray as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN: the role, its grant to Ray's role, and future grants (which need MANAGE GRANTS).
  PART B, run by the workstation as SYSADMIN (the owner), after part A: grants on existing objects.
*/

/* ===================== PART A (RAYSERRANO_ADMIN) ===================== */
USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS PILOT_READ_ROLE COMMENT = 'Reads Pilot (AGENTIC.DATASKILLS); never writes';
GRANT ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE TO ROLE SYSADMIN;

/* Granted to Ray's own role, his developer role (Ray, 2026-10-23: one role per person; no separate
   functional role). Read-only, so it adds nothing a dbt build could misuse. */
GRANT ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE TO ROLE DEV_RAYSERRANO_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON FUTURE TABLES IN SCHEMA AGENTIC.DATASKILLS TO ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON FUTURE VIEWS  IN SCHEMA AGENTIC.DATASKILLS TO ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE;

/* ===================== PART B (workstation, SYSADMIN) ===================== */
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH TO ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE AGENTIC TO ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA AGENTIC.DATASKILLS TO ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA AGENTIC.DATASKILLS TO ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL VIEWS  IN SCHEMA AGENTIC.DATASKILLS TO ROLE PILOT_READ_ROLE;
infra/snowflake/refresh_landing_tier.sql
/*
  Refresh one non-production landing tier from production landing (Ray, 2026-10-26, answer 1y; generalized to every
  tier 2026-10-28). The tiers are environment_tiers.sql's: LANDING_QA built by DV_QA_ROLE, and each developer's
  DEV__LANDING__<USER> built by DEV_<USER>_ROLE. The tier is replaced by a fresh clone of LANDING, owned by
  LANDING_ROLE, production's builder (DV_ROLE) removed, the tier's own builder and the reader granted, and its CONFIG
  emptied: production's builds write their findings and baselines into LANDING.CONFIG and the clone copies them
  (found 2026-10-28: 3 findings and 34 baselines), so every tier starts with no findings and no baselines of its own.

  Run by the workstation as SYSADMIN, statements on standard input, naming the tier:
    QA:          snow sql ... -D landing=LANDING_QA -D builder=DV_QA_ROLE < infra/snowflake/refresh_landing_tier.sql
    Development: snow sql ... -D landing=DEV__LANDING__CLAUDE_WS -D builder=DEV_CLAUDE_WS_ROLE < (the same)
  Safe to rerun: the clone is replaced each time. Refuses production: the target must not be LANDING.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;
USE WAREHOUSE COMPUTE_WH;

/* 0. Refuse production and unknown tiers before anything is replaced. */
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$
BEGIN
  IF ('<% landing %>' NOT IN ('LANDING_QA') AND NOT STARTSWITH('<% landing %>', 'DEV__LANDING__')) THEN
    RETURN 1/0;  -- stops the script: only LANDING_QA or a developer's DEV__LANDING__<USER> may be refreshed
  END IF;
  RETURN 'refreshing <% landing %> for <% builder %>';
END;
$$;

/* 1. A fresh clone of production landing. */
CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE <% landing %> CLONE LANDING;

/* 2. Owned by LANDING_ROLE, grants preserved. */
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL TABLES  IN DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE LANDING_ROLE COPY CURRENT GRANTS;

/* 3. Builder and reader grants, as the owner. Database-level grants do not survive a clone, but the clone's tables
   keep production's object grants, so production's builder, DV_ROLE, is removed first: each tier is built by its
   own builder alone (Ray, 2026-10-26, answer 1b). */
USE ROLE LANDING_ROLE;
REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN DATABASE <% landing %> FROM ROLE DV_ROLE;
REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE <% landing %> FROM ROLE DV_ROLE;
REVOKE ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE <% landing %> FROM ROLE DV_ROLE;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE <% builder %>;
GRANT USAGE ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE <% builder %>;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE <% builder %>;
GRANT CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, MODIFY ON SCHEMA <% landing %>.STORAGE TO ROLE <% builder %>;
GRANT CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, MODIFY ON SCHEMA <% landing %>.CONFIG TO ROLE <% builder %>;
GRANT INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA <% landing %>.CONFIG TO ROLE <% builder %>;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE LANDING_READ_ROLE;
GRANT USAGE ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE LANDING_READ_ROLE;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN DATABASE <% landing %> TO ROLE LANDING_READ_ROLE;

/* 4. The tier's own findings and baselines start empty: the clone copied production's. As the owner. */
TRUNCATE TABLE <% landing %>.CONFIG.DATA_FINDING;
TRUNCATE TABLE <% landing %>.CONFIG.BUILD_BASELINE;
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;

/* 5. Check: every LANDING source table has its twin in the tier with the same row count; CONFIG is checked in step
   6 instead, since the tier's is emptied on purpose. Returns zero rows when equal. */
SELECT p.TABLE_SCHEMA, p.TABLE_NAME, p.ROW_COUNT AS LANDING_ROWS, q.ROW_COUNT AS TIER_ROWS
FROM LANDING.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES p
FULL JOIN <% landing %>.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES q
  ON q.TABLE_SCHEMA = p.TABLE_SCHEMA AND q.TABLE_NAME = p.TABLE_NAME
WHERE COALESCE(p.TABLE_SCHEMA, q.TABLE_SCHEMA) NOT IN ('INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'CONFIG')
  AND (p.TABLE_NAME IS NULL OR q.TABLE_NAME IS NULL OR p.ROW_COUNT <> q.ROW_COUNT);

/* 6. Check: the tier's CONFIG is empty. Returns 0 and 0. */
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% landing %>.CONFIG.DATA_FINDING) AS TIER_FINDINGS,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <% landing %>.CONFIG.BUILD_BASELINE) AS TIER_BASELINES;
infra/snowflake/reset_vault_tier.sql
/*
  Clear a vault tier before a build that must be a true first build (Ray, 2026-10-26, answer 1y: D-41's QA rerun;
  generalized 2026-11-01 for the dev rehearsal, which runs everything QA will run before any pull request into qa).
  Drops the tier's built schemas; the next build recreates them, ghost records included. The MART views of release 1
  are dropped by infra/snowflake/drop_mart_views.sql after the build. Run with infra/snowflake/refresh_landing_tier.sql
  for the same tier, so landing and vault start clean together.

  Run by the workstation as SYSADMIN, statements on standard input, naming the vault:
    QA:          snow sql ... -D vault=DV_QA
    Development: snow sql ... -D vault=DEV__DV__CLAUDE_WS
  Refuses any database but DV_QA or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>, before anything changes. Idempotent.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$
BEGIN
  IF ('<% vault %>' <> 'DV_QA' AND NOT STARTSWITH('<% vault %>', 'DEV__DV__')) THEN
    RETURN 1/0;  -- stops the script: only DV_QA or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>, never production
  END IF;
  RETURN 'clearing the built schemas of <% vault %>';
END;
$$;

DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS <% vault %>.STAGING;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS <% vault %>.RAW_VAULT;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS <% vault %>.REFERENCE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS <% vault %>.CONFORMED_DM;
SELECT SCHEMA_NAME FROM <% vault %>.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('INFORMATION_SCHEMA', 'PUBLIC');
infra/snowflake/rollback_vault_to_time.sql
/*
  Roll a vault back to a recorded moment by Snowflake Time Travel (Ray, 2026-11-01: "we have time travel"; answer 1y).
  Before a promotion's production build, the promotion records the clock (SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) with its
  evidence; if the release must be undone, this script clones the vault as it stood at that clock, returns the clone
  and everything in it to the vault's owner with their grants, and swaps it in. The undone state stays behind as
  <vault>_ROLLBACK for inspection, and is dropped afterwards (DROP DATABASE <vault>_ROLLBACK, as SYSADMIN, once the rollback is verified). Time Travel reaches back as far as
  the vault's retention, one day on 2026-11-01. After the swap, in order: infra/snowflake/connector_read_grants.sql for the
  vault, since a clone does not carry grants on the database itself; dbt run-operation declare_vault_keys from the
  restored release's commit, since a clone at a past moment does not carry declared keys (found in the dev rehearsal,
  2026-11-01: 27 keys re-declared); the structure check against that commit's vault.sql and mart.sql; the code side is the revert of the release's
  commit on main and the functions redeployed from it.

  Run by the workstation as SYSADMIN, statements on standard input, naming the vault, the clock and the owner:
    snow sql ... -D vault=DV -D at='2026-11-01 16:30:00 +0000' -D owner=DV_ROLE
  Refuses any database but DV, DV_QA or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>, before anything changes. Rehearsed in a
  developer vault and in DV_QA before any production use, as every act is.
*/
USE ROLE SYSADMIN;

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$
BEGIN
  IF ('<% vault %>' NOT IN ('DV_QA', 'DV') AND NOT STARTSWITH('<% vault %>', 'DEV__DV__')) THEN
    RETURN 1/0;  -- stops the script: only DV, DV_QA or a developer's DEV__DV__<USER>
  END IF;
  RETURN 'rolling <% vault %> back to <% at %>';
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE DATABASE <% vault %>_ROLLBACK CLONE <% vault %> AT (TIMESTAMP => '<% at %>'::TIMESTAMP_TZ);
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON DATABASE <% vault %>_ROLLBACK TO ROLE <% owner %> COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL SCHEMAS IN DATABASE <% vault %>_ROLLBACK TO ROLE <% owner %> COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL TABLES IN DATABASE <% vault %>_ROLLBACK TO ROLE <% owner %> COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
GRANT OWNERSHIP ON ALL VIEWS IN DATABASE <% vault %>_ROLLBACK TO ROLE <% owner %> COPY CURRENT GRANTS;
ALTER DATABASE <% vault %> SWAP WITH <% vault %>_ROLLBACK;

/* The vault as restored: its schemas, tables and views. */
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS N FROM <% vault %>.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
 WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA <> 'INFORMATION_SCHEMA' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
infra/snowflake/service_users.sql
/*
  Service users: the identities dbt Cloud deployment jobs run as (Ray, 2026-10-23, answer 2y; split and renamed
  2026-10-26, answers 1b and 2y). A service user is named for the data product it serves, DV, never for the tool
  that runs it. QA and production are split, so a QA job pointed at production by mistake fails on privileges
  instead of writing there:

    DV_QA_DEPLOY  role DV_QA_ROLE   owns DV_QA; reads and writes LANDING_QA only (environment_tiers.sql, B3 and B5)
    DV_DEPLOY     role DV_ROLE      owns DV; reads and writes LANDING

  Both sign in only by key pair. Run by Ray as RAYSERRANO_ADMIN, before the workstation's part
  (infra/snowflake/dv_qa_role.sql). Then register each public key with
    infra/keys/new_developer_keypair.ps1 -User DV_QA_DEPLOY -Slot 1
    infra/keys/new_developer_keypair.ps1 -User DV_DEPLOY -Slot 1
  and put each private key only in its dbt Cloud environment's credentials.
  DBT_DEPLOY, the earlier name, is dropped if it was ever created; it held no key in use.
*/
USE ROLE USERADMIN;
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS DV_QA_ROLE
    COMMENT = 'Builder of DV_QA, the QA tier of the DV data product. Reads and writes LANDING_QA only.';
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS DV_QA_DEPLOY
    TYPE = SERVICE
    DEFAULT_ROLE = DV_QA_ROLE
    DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE = COMPUTE_WH
    COMMENT = 'dbt Cloud QA environment of the DV data product. Key pair only.';
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS DV_DEPLOY
    TYPE = SERVICE
    DEFAULT_ROLE = DV_ROLE
    DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE = COMPUTE_WH
    COMMENT = 'dbt Cloud production environment of the DV data product. Key pair only.';
DROP USER IF EXISTS DBT_DEPLOY;

USE ROLE SECURITYADMIN;
GRANT ROLE DV_QA_ROLE TO ROLE SYSADMIN;
GRANT ROLE DV_QA_ROLE TO USER DV_QA_DEPLOY;
GRANT ROLE DV_ROLE TO USER DV_DEPLOY;
SHOW GRANTS TO USER DV_QA_DEPLOY;
SHOW GRANTS TO USER DV_DEPLOY;
